T: Smurf cooks for her boys. Behave at the table.
D: A Melbourne teenager moves in with his grandmother and her family of armed robbers.
P: Serve the mains when Smurf puts dinner on the table for her boys.
S: Lemon garlic lamb grilled and wrapped in pita with tomato, onion and garlic yoghurt
Lamb shoulder strips marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled hot, wrapped in small pieces of warm pita with tomato, onion and garlic yoghurt.
Footy night pork and fennel sausage rolls
the boys on the couch with the footy on

Pork mince with fennel seed, grated apple and herbs rolled in flaky puff, sesame on top, baked golden and served hot with tomato relish. Mix 600g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 grated apple, 2 tsp toasted crushed fennel seeds, 40g breadcrumbs, chopped parsley, salt and pepper. Halve 3 sheets puff pastry, pipe a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal. Cut each into 4, brush with egg and sprinkle sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with tomato relish.
Slow-cooked onion folded into sour cream and cream cheese with chives
French onion dip of onions cooked slowly 40 minutes, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives, and thick ridged chips.
M: Smurf's roast lamb with mint sauce

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary and roasted pink, with crisp potatoes and pumpkin, peas, a proper gravy and sharp homemade mint sauce. Heat the oven to 220C. Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic slivers and rosemary, rub with oil and salt and roast 20 minutes, then at 180C for 60 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes and 600g pumpkin in oil alongside. Rest the lamb 20 minutes. Make gravy from the tray juices, 1 tbsp flour and 400ml stock. Pour 60ml boiling water over 2 tbsp sugar, stir in a cup of chopped mint and 80ml malt vinegar for the sauce. Cook 300g peas.
Crumbed chicken breast under ham, tomato sauce and melted mozzarella

Chicken breast crumbed and fried, topped with ham, Napoli sauce and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling, with chips and salad. Halve 2 chicken breasts and crumb them in flour, egg and panko. Shallow fry until golden and cooked through. Top with sliced ham, a spoon of crushed tomato simmered with garlic, and grated mozzarella. Grill until bubbling and serve with hot chips and a green salad.
W: Crisp puff pastry layers with thick vanilla custard and passionfruit icing
Puff pastry sheets baked flat, filled with a thick vanilla custard set with cornflour, topped with passionfruit icing, chilled and cut.
K: Lime cordial, lemon and bitters topped with lemonade over ice, no alcohol

The Aussie pub classic: lime cordial, fresh lemon and a good dash of aromatic bitters topped with lemonade over ice, pink and sharp. Fill 4 pot glasses with ice. Add 20ml lime cordial, the juice of a quarter lemon and 4 good dashes of aromatic bitters to each. Top with cold lemonade, stir once and add a lemon wedge. A pot of cold lager on the side for anyone after one.

s.note: Lemon garlic lamb grilled and wrapped in pita with tomato, onion and garlic yoghurt
s.how: Cut 600g lamb shoulder into strips and marinate in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill on high until charred. Wrap small pieces in torn warm pita with sliced tomato, onion and a spoon of garlic yoghurt, then pin with toothpicks.

s.note: Slow-cooked onion folded into sour cream and cream cheese with chives
s.how: Slice 3 onions thinly and cook in butter over low heat for 40 minutes until deep golden. Cool, then fold through 300ml sour cream and 125g softened cream cheese with chopped chives and salt. Chill for an hour and serve with a big bowl of ridged potato chips.

m.note: Crumbed chicken breast under ham, tomato sauce and melted mozzarella
m.how: Halve 2 chicken breasts and crumb them in flour, egg and panko. Shallow fry until golden and cooked through. Top with sliced ham, a spoon of crushed tomato simmered with garlic, and grated mozzarella. Grill until bubbling and serve with hot chips and a green salad.

w.note: Crisp puff pastry layers with thick vanilla custard and passionfruit icing
w.how: Bake 2 puff pastry sheets flat between trays at 200C until crisp. Whisk 750ml milk, 3 eggs, 150g sugar and 80g cornflour over heat until very thick. Spread between the sheets in a lined tin. Ice with icing mixed with passionfruit pulp, chill overnight and cut.

d.note: Lime cordial, lemon and bitters topped with lemonade over ice, no alcohol
d.how: Fill 4 pot glasses with ice. Add 20ml lime cordial, the juice of a quarter lemon and 4 good dashes of aromatic bitters to each. Top with cold lemonade, stir once and add a lemon wedge. A pot of cold lager on the side for anyone after one.
